list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT us_state FROM scores WHERE us_state IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT us_state FROM scores WHERE us_state IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: merch
list.label: Merch
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT merch FROM scores WHERE merch IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT merch FROM scores WHERE merch IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '10s'), count(*) / 10.0 AS tps FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (us_state = '$state' OR '$state' = '%') AND (merch = '$merch' OR '$merch' = '%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT floor(score * 10) / 10.0 AS score_bucket, count(*) AS transactions FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (us_state = '$state' OR '$state' = '%') AND (merch = '$merch' OR '$merch' = '%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Доля фрода по категории — последние 1000 транзакций
panels.description: Расчёт по последним 1000 строкам scores, до фильтрации по категории.

targets.rawSql: WITH recent AS (SELECT cat_id, fraud_flag FROM scores ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1000) SELECT cat_id, avg(fraud_flag::double precision) AS fraud_share FROM recent GROUP BY cat_id ORDER BY fraud_share DESC

panels.title: Средняя сумма подозрительных транзакций
panels.description: Сигнал для контроля финансового воздействия фрода.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1m'), avg(amount) FILTER (WHERE fraud_flag = 1) AS avg_fraud_amount FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Объём и доля фрода по версии модели

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_version, count(*) AS scores, sum(fraud_flag) AS fraud_count, avg(fraud_flag::double precision) AS fraud_share FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY model_version ORDER BY max(created_at) DESC
